deleteAccount.retentionBody: As a business owner you must keep your records for 7 years (tax retention requirement). Once deleted, we can't recover anything. So first download the ZIP with your complete records and store it somewhere safe, preferably in two places.
deleteAccount.zipContents: The ZIP contains: all your data per section as JSON and CSV (including customers, invoices, quotes with signature, expenses, bank transactions, hours, mileage, assets, products, recurring invoices, leave, tasks, team and webshop), your receipts and inbox attachments as separate files, and every invoice that isn't a draft as a PDF and as an e-invoice. A LEESMIJ.txt (read-me, in Dutch) explains what is where. Passwords, 2FA data and keys are not included.
deleteAccount.zipExtras: Useful extras for your accountant: the audit file (XAF) and the accountant export (CSV) per year. You download those separately under VAT; they are not in the ZIP.

fiscaleRust.title: Fiscale Rust

fiscaleRust.subtitleVpb: Estimate your company's VAT and profit tax reserve. Salary and dividends need a separate calculation.
fiscaleRust.estimateHint: A tool to help you set money aside. This calculation does not determine your tax bill.
fiscaleRust.periodHint: Enter revenue, costs and VAT for the same period. For a month or quarter, we project profit over a full year. No specific month or quarter is selected automatically.

fiscaleRust.manualError: Enter an amount from 0 to {max}, with no more than two decimal places.
fiscaleRust.costsHint: Exclude recoverable VAT from costs. VAT you cannot reclaim belongs in your costs. Also account for deduction limits and depreciation.
fiscaleRust.costsHintKor: Under KOR, you cannot deduct input VAT. Include this non-recoverable VAT in your business costs.
fiscaleRust.inputVatHint: Enter the VAT you are entitled to reclaim for this period. It is not inferred from your costs or your sales VAT rate.
fiscaleRust.korActive: KOR is enabled in your invoice settings: no VAT on this revenue and no deduction of input VAT.
fiscaleRust.vatTimingHint: A bank receipt does not automatically belong in the same VAT return period. Under the invoice system, the invoice date usually determines the period; under cash accounting, receipt does. Check which revenue and input VAT belong in this period.
fiscaleRust.csvSelectionHint: No transactions are selected when the file opens. Choose only revenue from the selected period. Exclude loans, transfers and personal deposits. Selected amounts are used only after you apply them.

fiscaleRust.csvError: This CSV could not be processed. Check its contents and use a maximum of 2 MB and 10,000 rows.
fiscaleRust.csvSelectionError: Select revenue from the chosen year, with a total no greater than {max}.
fiscaleRust.ibHint: 30% is only a starting value, not your personal tax rate or a guarantee of a sufficient reserve. Entrepreneur deductions, the SME profit exemption, tax credits and other income are not included. Match your percentage to your expected tax bill. For a partnership (vof), income tax and Zvw must be calculated per partner; this calculator does not allocate profit or personal annual limits across multiple partners.
fiscaleRust.safetyLabel: Extra margin on the tax reserve
fiscaleRust.safetyHint: This margin is added to VAT, profit tax and any Zvw contribution. It starts at 10%; even with a margin, the result remains an estimate.
fiscaleRust.advancedTitle: Mixed VAT and your annual profit projection
fiscaleRust.customVatLabel: I know the actual VAT included in my revenue
fiscaleRust.outputVatHint: Use this for mixed VAT rates or a known VAT total. It replaces the single-rate calculation and cannot exceed the revenue entered.
fiscaleRust.annualProfitLabel: Expected profit for the whole year (optional)
fiscaleRust.annualProfitHint: Expected annual profit after business costs. This replaces the multiplication of your period profit. Entrepreneur deductions, exemptions, credits and prior losses are not applied automatically. You may enter a negative loss.
fiscaleRust.amountError: Check ‘{field}’. Use no more than two decimal places and an amount up to {max}. Only annual profit may be negative; output VAT cannot exceed revenue.
fiscaleRust.calculationError: These inputs could not be calculated. Check the amounts and use no more than two decimal places.
fiscaleRust.emptyState: Enter revenue and choose Calculate, or review and apply a selection from your bank CSV.
fiscaleRust.bufferSub: Based on {amount} revenue in the selected period, including your chosen extra margin.
fiscaleRust.freeHint: This is not a bank balance or money available to spend. Outstanding invoices, debts, investments, personal withdrawals and tax already paid are not included.
fiscaleRust.splitTitle: What your estimated reserve consists of

btw.label: VAT reserve
btw.sub: Output VAT less actual deductible input VAT.

ib.label: Income tax reserve
ib.sub: Based on your percentage and projected annual profit.

zvw.label: Zvw reserve
zvw.sub: Annual contribution on the profit base, allocated to this period.

vpb.label: Corporate tax reserve
vpb.sub: Annual bands applied to projected profit, allocated to this period.

safety.label: Extra margin
safety.sub: Additional reserve on top of the calculated tax buffer.

free.label: Profit remaining after reserves
free.sub: Profit after the profit tax reserve, any Zvw and extra margin. Not a cash or bank balance.

fiscaleRust.vpbHint: {year} rates: {low} up to {threshold} annual profit and {high} above that. The annual reserve is allocated to the selected period.
fiscaleRust.dgaHint: Customary director salary, payroll taxes and taxes on dividends are not calculated. Include business salary costs in your profit projection and have your personal tax assessed separately.
fiscaleRust.legalFormNote: Change your legal form under Settings → Company details.
fiscaleRust.shortfall: The entered costs and reserves exceed revenue by {amount}. This scenario leaves no profit after reserves; check your funding and annual projection.
fiscaleRust.vatRefund: Input VAT exceeds output VAT by {amount}. This potential VAT credit is shown separately and does not count as available money.
fiscaleRust.korExceeded: The revenue entered for this period already exceeds the annual KOR threshold of {threshold}. We therefore do not show a KOR-based reserve: VAT around the threshold crossing cannot be determined from one total. Review your transactions and KOR setting with your accountant before recalculating.
fiscaleRust.korProjected: At the same revenue in each period, annual revenue would exceed the KOR threshold of {threshold}. This is a projection, not a confirmed breach. Track your actual annual revenue.
fiscaleRust.projectionHint: Annual projected profit equals period profit × {count}. Annual rates, caps and bands are applied to that projection first; the annual reserve is then divided by {count}. Uneven revenue may produce a different annual result.
fiscaleRust.projectionOverrideHint: Your own annual profit projection replaces the automatic estimate. We use it to calculate the annual reserve and divide that by {count}. This spreads the reserve evenly across the year and does not reconcile tax already paid.
fiscaleRust.zvwExplanation: Zvw {year}: {rate} on contribution income up to {max} per year, then divided across {count} period(s). Your projected profit is used as a simplified contribution base. Zvw already charged through wages or benefits is not included.
fiscaleRust.calculationLimits: Tax deductions, exemptions, tax credits, prior losses and other income are not applied automatically. Negative profit remains visible; a potential VAT refund does not fund the reserve.

cancel.a: Yes. Your subscription is always cancellable per month, with no notice period or fine print. You keep access until the end of the paid period.

avg.q: What about my privacy and GDPR?
avg.a: Your books are kept in a database in Ireland and the app runs in Frankfurt. Emails, such as invoices and password resets, are sent through Resend, an American company. Sensitive data, such as connected keys and your 2FA secret, is additionally encrypted. We sign a data processing agreement with you and you can have your data deleted at any time.

tax.q: Is this suitable for the tax authorities?
tax.a: Saldova helps you put the required details on your invoice, keeps business and private trips apart and prepares your figures as PDF or export. Have your tax return checked by your accountant.

data.q: Can I take my data with me if I leave?
data.a: Yes, you can export all your invoices and records. You're never locked in and you remain the owner of your own data.

switch.q: Can I switch from another program?
switch.a: Bring customers from a CSV export. Choose I am switching during setup, review the preview and confirm the import. Import bank transactions separately using a bank CSV. Keep historical invoices and tax returns as an archive and reconcile outstanding items with your accountant.

start.a: Within a minute. Create a free account with your email, add your company details later, and you can create your first invoice right away.

trial.a: Yes. New sole trader and webshop accounts get 30 days of Growth for free, no credit card needed. After that you automatically continue on the free plan, with up to 5 invoices a month. Your data stays. Company accounts start with 30 days of Business. Shop connections require the Webshop plan. Compare plans before choosing.

payment.q: Which payment methods do you support?
payment.a: Online payment follows at the official launch. Until then you start for free and pay nothing. Before launch we'll explain how payment works.
payment.aLaunched: You pay monthly via Mollie. You make the first payment on Mollie's payment page, where you can see which payment methods you can choose. After that, the monthly amount is collected automatically by direct debit.

invoiceLegal.q: Do the invoices meet legal requirements?
invoiceLegal.a: Saldova helps you put the required details on your invoice, such as invoice number, dates, VAT and your company details. You download the invoice as PDF. Have your tax return checked by your accountant.

support.a: Send your question through the contact form. On a paid plan, from Growth, you can also use the support chat in the app. Pro, Webshop and the business plans get priority support: their open questions in the support chat go to the top of our queue.

security.q: Is my financial data safe with Saldova?
security.a: Your books are kept in a database in Ireland (EU) and the app runs in Frankfurt. Emails are sent through Resend, an American company. Sensitive data, such as connected keys and your 2FA secret, is additionally encrypted. You can always export your data or have it deleted.

exportData.q: Can I export my data if I want to leave?
exportData.a: Yes. Under Settings you can download your complete records as a ZIP at any time: all your data as JSON and CSV, your receipts and inbox attachments, and every invoice that isn't a draft as a PDF and e-invoice. Hours and mileage can also be exported separately as CSV.

changePlan.q: Can I change my subscription mid-term?
changePlan.a: From the official launch you can change your plan at any time. Until then you use the free plan (new sole trader accounts get 30 days of Growth first), or the Business trial if you are a company.
changePlan.aLaunched: Yes, but not with one click yet. Cancel your subscription under Settings → Subscription and then pick another plan. The new plan starts with a new first payment.

plans.q: What is the difference between Growth and Pro?
plans.a: Growth (€ 15 per month) has unlimited invoices and customers, quotes, projects, Tax Peace of Mind, payment reminders and your own branding on invoices: your logo, an accent color and your own footer text. Pro (€ 29 per month) has everything in Growth, plus priority support: your questions in the support chat go to the top of our queue. Prices exclude VAT. With the free plan you can make up to 5 invoices a month for up to 3 customers.

wsPlatforms.a: Yes, with the Webshop package. Shopify, WooCommerce and Bol.com connect directly with a connection code (API key) from your webshop, with read-only access. Other platforms like Etsy and Amazon can be imported via a CSV export. More info on the For webshops page.

wsOss.q: Does Saldova calculate VAT per EU country?
wsOss.a: Yes. Saldova tracks the €10,000 threshold for sales to consumers in other EU countries and shows revenue and VAT per country, so your OSS return is ready quickly. It remains a tool: if in doubt, ask your accountant.

stopping.a: Then we'll let you know by email at least {days} days in advance. That gives you plenty of time to download your full export and switch. The export is available on every plan, including the free plan: all your data as JSON and CSV, your receipts as separate files and your invoices as PDF and e-invoice.

about.title: Our mission: administrative calm for freelancers, starters and small webshops.
about.intro: For too many entrepreneurs, admin is too complex, too slow and too expensive. Saldova turns that around: one sleek, lightning-fast tool that handles your admin in minutes — so you spend your time on your business, not your bookkeeping.

speed.title: Speed above all
speed.desc: No sluggish software or endless loading times. Everything in Saldova is built to load and work within seconds.

privacy.title: Privacy & security
privacy.desc: Your data is yours. Sensitive data is additionally encrypted and your books are kept in a database in the EU. Emails go through Resend, an American company.

simple.title: Simplicity pays off
simple.desc: No superfluous features you never use. Only the tools you actually need to run your business.

about.philosophyTitle: Software adapts to you. Not the other way around.
about.philosophyBody1: Most accounting software forces you into an accountant’s logic: modules, codes and screens designed for number crunchers, not entrepreneurs. We flip that around. Saldova is built around how you work — creating an invoice, logging hours, recording a trip — in as few steps as possible.
about.philosophyBody2: Every feature has to earn its place. Anything you do not need, we leave out. What remains is a tool that is fast, clear and does exactly what you expect. That is how software should work: invisible in the background, while you run your business.
about.ctaSubtitle: No sales pitch — try Saldova yourself and see within a minute whether it fits.
about.backgroundLead: Saldova wasn't dreamed up on a drawing board. It grew out of practice, and I use it myself.
about.backgroundP1: Over the past year I've built websites and digital solutions for freelancers and small businesses. That showed me up close how entrepreneurs work, where they get stuck and what they really need.
about.backgroundP2: The same problem kept coming up in those projects: the admin. Entrepreneurs lost time and overview to a patchwork of separate tools: one app for invoices, another for hours, yet another for VAT. Work that isn't running a business, but comes back every week.
about.backgroundP3: Saldova is my answer to that: one tool that is clean, fast and easy to understand, built from the daily reality of entrepreneurs. It grows with the people who use it.
about.backgroundP4: I'm 18 and I use Saldova myself, every day, for my own bookkeeping. So I'm the first to notice what doesn't work well, and I fix it right away. Saldova is young, and I'm honest about that. In return, every question and idea goes straight to the maker.

s1.title: Your invoices at a glance
s1.body: These counters show at a glance how much has been paid and what amount is still outstanding. You know exactly which invoices need chasing.

s2.title: Create a new invoice
s2.body: This starts a new invoice. VAT and totals are calculated automatically, so your invoice is ready within a few minutes.

s3.title: Search and filter your invoices
s3.body: Search by customer or invoice number and filter by status or period. That way you can pull up, say, all outstanding invoices for this quarter in one go.

s4.title: Export for your accountant
s4.body: Download your filtered invoices as a CSV file. Handy for handing your accountant a tidy overview in a single click.

s1.title: All your quotes in one place
s1.body: Here you manage all your quotes, from first draft to accepted job. You will never lose track of what you offered a client.

s2.title: Create a new quote
s2.body: Put together a quote here with your own line items and prices. Your client receives a clean PDF and can respond right away, without endless email back and forth.

s3.title: Track every quote's status
s3.body: Once you have sent quotes, you see for each one whether it was accepted, declined or is still open. You know exactly which client could use a friendly follow-up call.

s1.title: A quote ready in one minute
s1.body: This is your fastest route to a quote: just a client name and a few lines. Ideal when you are with a client and want to give a price on the spot.

s2.title: Line items with automatic VAT
s2.body: Enter a description, quantity and price per line. Saldova instantly works out the subtotal, VAT and total for you, so there is nothing to calculate yourself.

s3.title: Generate a shareable link
s3.body: One click creates the quote and gives you a link you can text or email straight away. Your client views the quote online and can accept immediately.

s4.title: Your quick quotes, live
s4.body: Your latest quick quotes appear here with their status. The list refreshes itself, so you see it the moment a client accepts.

s1.title: Your expenses at a glance
s1.body: See right away what you've spent this year or quarter and how much VAT you can reclaim. That input VAT lowers your next VAT return.

s2.title: Add an expense
s2.body: Click here to record a business expense. Snap a photo of the receipt right away and your records are complete in one go.

s3.title: Filter by quarter
s3.body: View your expenses per quarter — exactly the period of your VAT return. In seconds you know which costs belong in which return.

s4.title: All your receipts in one place
s4.body: Every expense is listed here with its amount, VAT and receipt. If the tax office ever asks for proof, you open the receipt with one click.

s5.title: Receipts by email
s5.body: Send receipts from your phone to your own inbox address (see Settings). They show up here; Process opens the form with the photo and the scanner reads amount, date and VAT.

s1.title: Your money flow at a glance
s1.body: Instantly see what came in and went out, and how many payments are already linked to an invoice. You know where you stand without any math.

s2.title: Import your bank statement
s2.body: Download a CSV from your bank and drop it here. Saldova reads the transactions and automatically skips duplicates.

s3.title: Smart match suggestions
s3.body: Saldova recognises which incoming payments belong to which open invoice and lines them up here. One click to confirm and the invoice is marked as paid.

s4.title: All your transactions by month
s4.body: After an import your transactions appear here neatly grouped by month. Link payments to invoices or ignore private entries to keep things tidy.

s1.title: Your return, pre-filled
s1.body: These are exactly the amounts you enter with the tax office, box by box. Copy them over and you're done — no more manual math at filing time.

s2.title: Pick your filing period
s2.body: Switch quarters here. Handy when you want to check an earlier return or see how this quarter is shaping up.

s3.title: Pay or get money back
s3.body: This balance is the VAT you owe minus your input VAT. You know exactly how much to set aside for the tax office — no surprises at filing time.

s4.title: Export for your accountant
s4.body: Working with an accountant? Download all your figures for the year in one go. Saves emails and loose files going back and forth.

s1.title: Your hours at a glance
s1.body: See right away how many hours are still open and what they're worth. That way you know exactly what you can still invoice.

s2.title: Add hours or export
s2.body: With + New you log a work session in seconds. Ready for your bookkeeping? Export everything as CSV for your accountant.

s3.title: Let the timer do the clocking
s3.body: Start the timer when you begin working and stop it when you're done — the hours are filled in automatically. It even keeps running if you refresh the page.

s4.title: Compare your months side by side
s4.body: This chart shows your hours per month for the past six months, so you instantly see whether you're on track or a month is falling behind.

s5.title: Review your team’s hours
s5.body: Hours logged by employees land here first. Approve or reject them one by one (with a reason) or all at once. Only approved hours can be invoiced — the employee is notified automatically.

s1.title: Every kilometre counts
s1.body: Here you see your business and private kilometres and what you can deduct at €0.23 per kilometre. That way no tax benefit slips through.

s2.title: Add a trip or export
s2.body: With + New you record a trip: from, to and the distance. Tick round trip and the return leg is added automatically. You can also export everything as CSV here.

s3.title: Business and private kept separate
s3.body: Filter here between business and private trips. The tax office wants to see that split, and you see exactly which kilometres earn you money.

s4.title: Your kilometres per month
s4.body: This chart shows your business kilometres for the past six months — handy for spotting a month where you forgot to log trips.

s1.title: Your workload in numbers
s1.body: See how many tasks are open, in progress and past their deadline. Every morning you know exactly where to start.

s2.title: Create your first task
s2.body: Click here to create a task with a deadline, priority and optionally a project or customer. Everything you need to do lives in one place.

s3.title: Drag tasks to the right column
s3.body: This board works like a kanban: drag a card to in progress or done, or use the buttons on the card. Overdue tasks automatically float to the top.

s4.title: Find the right task fast
s4.body: Search by name, filter by priority, or switch between your own tasks and the whole team's. Handy once the board fills up.

s1.title: Estimate your tax reserve
s1.body: Choose the year and period, then enter revenue, business costs and actual deductible input VAT. The result estimates a reserve; it is not a tax assessment.

s2.title: Review your bank CSV
s2.body: Open a CSV and choose which incoming transactions represent revenue in the selected period. They are applied only after you confirm. Processing stays in your browser.

s3.title: Adjust your reserve
s3.body: For income tax, choose your own reserve percentage. The starting value is no guarantee of a sufficient reserve. A bv uses the annual corporate tax bands.

s4.title: Review your estimate
s4.body: This shows reserves, the extra margin and calculation steps. Remaining profit is not a bank balance. Review your assumptions and annual projection with your accountant.

s1.title: Your projects at a glance
s1.body: These counters show how many projects you have, which ones are active and how many clients you work for. You'll instantly know where your time is going.

s2.title: Start a new project
s2.body: Create a project here with a client and hourly rate. Hours and trips you log against it will automatically be ready for invoicing later on.

s3.title: Archive finished projects
s3.body: Done with a job? Archive the project: your list stays tidy while all hours and trips are kept. Tick this box to bring them back into view.

s4.title: Export for your records
s4.body: Download your project list as a CSV, including rates, hours and trips. Great for sharing with your accountant or keeping in your own records.

s1.title: Your customers in numbers
s1.body: See how many customers you have, who has already received invoices and what each relationship brings in. You'll know at a glance who your key customers are.

s2.title: Add a customer
s2.body: Set up a customer here with their address and VAT number. When you invoice, all details are filled in correctly right away — saving you lookups and mistakes.

s3.title: Find the right customer fast
s3.body: Type a name, email address or city and the list filters instantly. Even with dozens of customers you'll find the right one in seconds.

s4.title: Export your customer list
s4.body: Download your customers as a CSV, including revenue per customer. Useful for your accountant or for working with the data outside Saldova.

s1.title: Your team at a glance
s1.body: See how many seats you're using and what your team costs extra per month. That way you know exactly where you stand before adding someone.

s2.title: Invite your first team member
s2.body: One click creates an account for a colleague: name, email and password, done. As the owner you also decide right away whether someone becomes a manager.

s3.title: Who does what
s3.body: This overview shows booked hours, kilometers and invoices per team member. You can see who's working on what without having to ask around.

s1.title: Your leave balance at a glance
s1.body: These cards show your total budget, what you've already taken and what's still pending. You'll know exactly how many hours you have left before requesting anything.

s2.title: Request leave in a minute
s2.body: Pick the type, the period and the number of hours, then submit. As an employer you can also log your own days off here — they're approved instantly.

s3.title: All requests in one place
s3.body: Track the status of every request here: pending, approved or rejected. You can also withdraw an open request yourself.

s4.title: Budgets per employee
s4.body: As a manager you set each person's leave budget here — change the number and it's saved instantly. That way nobody slips into the red unnoticed.

s1.title: Your account's logbook
s1.body: Every important action in your administration is recorded here: who did what, and when. Useful when you work with a team and want to trace something back.

s2.title: Who, what and when
s2.body: Each row shows the time, the person and the action — with a color label per category, so invoices, leave or team changes stand out immediately.

s3.title: Find it in seconds
s3.body: Type a name or action into the search field at the top and the list filters instantly. In seconds you'll see who changed that one invoice.

s1.title: Your account at a glance
s1.body: Here you can see at a glance the name you work under, your account type and your current plan. That way you instantly know everything is set up right.

s2.title: Keep your details up to date
s2.body: Fill in your name, language and company details here. Your registration and VAT numbers will be correct everywhere — saving you hassle on every invoice.

s3.title: Manage your subscription here
s3.body: See your current plan, its status and when it renews. Upgrade or cancel yourself, right here — no emails or waiting required.

s4.title: Your data stays yours
s4.body: Download a full export of your data at any time. Great for your own records, and you always stay in control.

s5.title: Your receipt address
s5.body: This secret email address is yours alone. Save it as a contact on your phone and email receipts to it — they land in Expenses.

s1.title: Saldova as a Windows app
s1.body: This page is where you get Saldova as a real Windows app. Your admin in its own window, always within reach next to your other programs.

s2.title: Get the app right here
s2.body: This block shows your personal status: if you can download, the button is ready here. If not, you'll see exactly what's still needed.

s3.title: What you get
s3.body: The same familiar Saldova, but faster and in its own window. Your data stays secure and automatically in sync with the web version.

s4.title: Free on your phone, always
s4.body: Using Saldova on your phone costs nothing extra. The Windows app is a bonus — on the go you simply keep working for free.

exportGuarantee.title: Your data stays yours. Always.
exportGuarantee.intro: Saldova is a new brand. So you want to be sure your records can never get stuck. That's why we put in writing what you can always do, and what happens when you cancel, delete your account, or if Saldova ever shuts down.

summary.own: Your data is yours, and you can take it all out in one go.
summary.always: You can export everything on every plan, including the free one.
summary.stop: If Saldova ever shuts down, you'll hear at least {days} days in advance.

own.title: Your data stays yours
own.desc: Everything you put into Saldova, such as customers, invoices, hours, trips and receipts, stays yours. You can take it all out in one go, as ordinary files you can open without Saldova.

always.title: Export on every plan
always.desc: The full export is included in every plan, including the free plan. It costs nothing extra. Even after your trial has ended or you've cancelled your subscription, you can still download your export. The account owner can, and so can a team member or your accountant if you've given them the right to export. One exception: if we suspend or end an account because of misuse, non-payment or a breach of the terms, this promise doesn't apply automatically. In that case, please get in touch with us about your data.

cancel.title: When you cancel
cancel.desc: Cancelling stops the monthly charge through Mollie. We don't delete anything: your customers, invoices, receipts and other data stay where they are. You can still download your full export afterwards.

stop.title: If Saldova shuts down
stop.desc: If Saldova ever shuts down, we'll let all customers know by email at least {days} days in advance. That gives you plenty of time to download your full export and move to another package. The export keeps working during that period.

contents.title: What's in the export
contents.desc: You download the full export in Saldova under Settings. You get one ZIP file containing:

delete.title: When you delete your account
delete.desc: Deleting erases everything and can't be undone. That's why it always happens in this order:

contents.data: All your data as JSON and CSV: customers, invoices, quotes, hours, trips, expenses, bank transactions, products and more. You can open a CSV file in Excel or Numbers.
contents.files: Your receipts and the attachments from your receipts inbox as separate files, such as photos and PDFs.
contents.invoices: Every invoice that is no longer a draft, as PDF and as e-invoice (UBL). You can import an e-invoice into another accounting package.
contents.readme: A README file that explains what is where.

exportGuarantee.auditfileTitle: Plus: the audit file for your accounting package
exportGuarantee.auditfileDesc: You can also download an audit file (XAF) per year with your invoices and expenses. It's a standard file that accounting packages such as Exact, SnelStart, e-Boekhouden and Twinfield can import. You'll find it in Saldova under VAT, together with the journal entries as CSV. If a business account's trial has ended or its subscription has been cancelled, you can no longer open VAT. The audit file per year is then on the screen you see, next to the full export. It isn't in the ZIP, but the data it's made from is.
exportGuarantee.notIncludedDesc: Passwords, two-factor authentication details and the keys of your webshop connections. They're only for signing in or connecting and don't belong in an archive. Drafts are in your data, but not as PDF: a draft isn't an invoice yet.

export.title: Your export first
export.desc: Before you can delete, we ask you to download the full export and confirm that you've saved it. You're required to keep your records for 7 years.

password.title: Then your password
password.desc: You confirm with your password. That way nobody who gets to your signed-in screen can erase your records.

billing.title: Stop payments
billing.desc: We cancel your subscription with Mollie and stop the automatic charge. If that fails, we delete nothing and you can try again later.

erase.title: Only then erase
erase.desc: Then we delete your account with all its data. This can't be undone, so keep your export safe.

exportGuarantee.deleteNote: Are you a team member in someone else's account? Then you only delete your own login. The records stay with the account owner.
exportGuarantee.deleteGateNote: Has a business account's trial ended or its subscription been cancelled? Then you can no longer open Settings. Download your export first and ask us through the contact form to delete your account. Even then, we only erase after it's been confirmed that your export is saved and the payments with Mollie have stopped.

exportGuarantee.questionsDesc: Want to know what the export looks like, or how to switch? Feel free to get in touch.

securityPage.title: How we protect your books.
securityPage.intro: Your books are sensitive. This page explains what Saldova actually does to protect them, where your data is kept and which services we use. No big words, and including what we don't do yet.

summary.location: Your books are kept in a database in Ireland and the app runs in Frankfurt. Emails are sent through Resend, an American company.
summary.encryption: Always a secure connection (HTTPS). A few sensitive fields are additionally encrypted with AES-256-GCM.
summary.login: Passwords are only stored as a bcrypt hash. You can turn on two-factor authentication with an authenticator app.
summary.team: In a team, everyone only sees what their role allows. Your accountant can look along without access to your settings.
summary.report: Found a vulnerability? Report it through the contact form. Our security.txt points the way too.

location.title: Where your data is
location.desc: Saldova uses a few service providers. This is where your data is stored and processed.

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.desc: Everything between your browser and Saldova goes over a secure connection. In the database we additionally encrypt a few sensitive fields. Only the fields below: not all of your books.

login.title: Signing in
login.desc: This is how we keep your account locked, even when someone tries to guess your password.

team.title: Permissions in a team
team.desc: If you work with team members or an accountant, their role decides what they see and can do. As the owner you can adjust those permissions per person.

monitoring.title: Watching for suspicious traffic
monitoring.desc: Saldova uses Wardova Shield, the security service of Wardova (like Saldova, part of Ova Groep). Shield runs in monitor mode for us: it reports suspicious traffic, such as known attack bots or a burst of requests, but doesn't block anything yet.

processors.title: Services we use
processors.desc: These are the service providers (sub-processors) from our privacy statement. We have agreements with them on security and confidentiality.

backups.title: Backups
backups.desc: We currently don't promise a backup period or recovery time, because we can't demonstrate one yet. If you want to be sure of your data, download a full export yourself regularly. That works in every plan. As a business owner you have to keep your records for 7 years anyway.

report.title: Report a security issue
report.desc: Think you've found a vulnerability in Saldova? Let us know through the contact form.

breach.title: If something does go wrong
breach.desc: In case of a data breach we follow the rules of the GDPR. These are the obligations we then meet:

app.title: The app
app.desc: Saldova runs on Vercel in the Frankfurt region (fra1). The server functions and the connection to the database run in Frankfurt. The first check of your request (the language, whether the request comes from Saldova itself, and Wardova Shield) happens on Vercel's global network, close to where you are.

database.title: The database
database.desc: Your books are kept in a database at Supabase in Ireland: your invoices, customers, hours and trips, and also your receipts and attachments.

email.title: Email
email.desc: Emails Saldova sends, such as invoices, reminders and password resets, go through Resend. Resend is an American company, so those emails may be processed outside the EU.

securityPage.locationNote: Vercel and Supabase are American companies too, although their servers for Saldova are in the EU. Where data may end up outside the European Economic Area, this happens on the basis of the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, as our privacy statement also says.

securityPage.httpsDesc: All connections to Saldova use HTTPS. Nobody along the way can read what you enter.
securityPage.notEncryptedDesc: The rest of your books, such as invoices and amounts, customer names and email addresses, postcodes, hours, trips and receipts, is stored in the database without this extra encryption. In the app, only people with the right permissions can see that data.

bcrypt.title: Passwords as a hash
bcrypt.desc: We never store your password in readable form, only as a bcrypt hash. We can't see it either.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.desc: Turn on two-factor authentication in Settings with an authenticator app. You get 10 one-time backup codes with it. We only store those as a hash.

limits.title: A brake on guessing
limits.desc: After {failures} failed attempts for an email address within {failureMinutes} minutes, signing in with that address is paused for a while, from any IP address. On top of that, each IP address is limited to {ipLimit} sign-in attempts per {ipMinutes} minutes, even when every attempt uses a different email address.

sessions.title: Old sessions expire
sessions.desc: If you change your password or turn two-factor authentication on or off, earlier sessions stop working. If a team member is removed, their access ends right away.

securityPage.limitsNote: Honest about the limits: these limits are kept in memory per server. They slow down simple guessing, but they're not watertight protection against large attacks from many addresses at once. For an unknown email address the response takes as long as for an existing one, so you can't tell which addresses have an account.

owner.title: Owner
owner.desc: Can do everything and is the only one who manages the company profile, subscription and branding. Sets the permissions of team members.

manager.title: Manager
manager.desc: Approves hours, manages the team and sees the activity log. No invoices, bank or VAT by default.

accountant.title: Accountant
accountant.desc: Has access to invoices, quotes, expenses, customers, bank and VAT, and can make exports. Doesn't see staff data or company settings.

employee.title: Employee
employee.desc: Gets none of these extra permissions by default: no finances, no approving other people's hours, no team management and no exports.

securityPage.accountantDesc: From a paid plan you can give one accountant their own login. It doesn't count as a team member. You can always revoke the access; that login is then deleted.
securityPage.teamCheckDesc: Permissions are checked on the server, not just by hiding buttons. Important actions, such as exports, new team members and changed permissions, go into an activity log that the owner and managers can view.
securityPage.shieldDataDesc: Only for a suspicious request: the IP address, the requested page, the browser information (user agent) and the country. Normal visits are not passed on. If Wardova can't be reached, Saldova simply keeps working.
securityPage.otherDesc: Requests that change something in your books must come from Saldova itself: we refuse such requests from other sites. Other sites can't load Saldova in a frame either.

vercel.name: Vercel
vercel.role: Hosting of the website and app. Servers in Frankfurt (Germany).

mollie.name: Mollie (Netherlands)
mollie.role: Payments for your subscription via iDEAL and credit card.

resend.name: Resend (United States)
resend.role: Sending emails, such as invoices, reminders and password resets.

wardova.name: Wardova (Ova Groep)
wardova.role: Security with Wardova Shield, in monitor mode.

mindee.name: Mindee (France)
mindee.role: Reading receipts automatically, only when that feature is on. Otherwise this happens in your own browser.

webshops.name: Shopify, WooCommerce and Bol.com
webshops.role: Only if you create a connection yourself. Saldova then fetches your orders.

reportAsks.what: Describe what you found and how we can check it. Put in the subject that it's about security.
reportAsks.own: Only test with your own account. Don't look at other people's data and don't change it.
reportAsks.time: Give us time to fix it before you publish anything about it.

securityPage.securityTxtDesc: For those who look for it automatically: how to report a security issue is also in /.well-known/security.txt (following RFC 9116).

breach.ap: If a data breach poses a risk to the people whose data it is, we report it to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens) within 72 hours of discovery. That is a legal obligation.
breach.customers: If the breach affects data you keep in Saldova, such as your customers' data, we let you know without undue delay and at the latest within 48 hours of discovery, so you can decide whether you need to report it yourself. That's what the data processing agreement says.
breach.people: If the risk is high for people whose data we manage ourselves, such as you as an account holder, we tell them directly too.
breach.log: We also record breaches we don't have to report, as the GDPR requires.

securityPage.companyIntro: Saldova is a new brand. These are our company details, as far as they're known now.
securityPage.questionsDesc: Ask them through the contact form. If it's about a vulnerability, mention that it's about security.

audience.title: Who is Saldova for?
audience.intro: Saldova is made for entrepreneurs who do their own admin, without a regular accountant. For some businesses it is not the right choice (yet). We would rather say so up front.
audience.introCompanies: Business and Business+ are for small teams that do their own admin. Saldova focuses mainly on freelancers, starters and webshops, and for some businesses it is not the right choice (yet). We would rather say so up front.

team.title: Small teams with staff
team.desc: Business up to {business} employees, Business+ up to {max}. Each employee has their own login and role, requests leave, logs hours and gets tasks. Payroll is not included.

zzp.title: Freelancers without a regular accountant
zzp.desc: You do your own admin, perhaps in Excel or Word today. Saldova creates your invoices, tracks your hours and works out what to set aside for tax.

starter.title: Starters
starter.desc: Just registered with the Chamber of Commerce (KvK)? The free plan lets you create up to {invoices} invoices a month and track your hours and mileage. The tax buffer (Tax Peace) starts with Growth.

freelance.title: Contractors
freelance.desc: Invoice by the hour or per project, with a payment QR code and an e-invoice (UBL) your client can import.

webshop.title: Small webshops
webshop.desc: With the Webshop package you connect WooCommerce, Shopify or Bol.com (or import a CSV), and Saldova works out the VAT per EU country for your OSS return.

bv.title: Private limited companies (bv) needing a ledger and annual accounts
bv.desc: Saldova has no general ledger of its own and does not prepare annual accounts. For a bv you need an accountant or another package for that.

pos.title: Restaurants and salons with a till
pos.desc: There is no connection to a point-of-sale system, so your till revenue does not flow into Saldova by itself.

care.title: Care providers who submit claims
care.desc: You cannot submit claims to health insurers or municipalities through Saldova.

payroll.title: Larger teams with payroll
payroll.desc: Saldova does not run payroll. Business (up to {business} employees) and Business+ (up to {max} employees) are for small teams, for leave, hours and tasks.

audience.doubt: Not sure whether Saldova fits you?

startgesprek.title: Free {minutes}-minute intro call
startgesprek.text: We help you get started or switch from another package. Send us a message through the contact form; we will get in touch to pick a time.
